evidence_scope: Pinned official source; selected semantic traces and complete dialogue/module census; no native execution or installed-build parity

sources.symbols: HasTech, GrantTech, GetNextTechForSale, DeltaCredit, AlienRaces, DoBuy, DoSell, DoRescue

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Conversation is a C callback graph over stable phrase references, not a generic dialogue-tree asset. Local phrase suppression and durable game flags have different lifetimes.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Alien voice joins distinct wording, response intents, repeated-visit greetings, authored stance and portrait/music/animation definitions. It is more than replacing a species name in a neutral template.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Melnorme information purchases can set knowledge flags consumed by another encounter; Syreen talk separates learned suspicion from carrying physical evidence.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Progress carried between places includes the same flagship fuel/cargo/modules, escort queue, technology availability, known information and authored alliances. The inspected loop centers expedition capability rather than a unified character XP currency.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Planets change expedition choices through landing fuel, weather/tectonic/temperature hazard chances, cargo limits and authored generation overrides. They do not each replace the game engine or power rules.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: HyperSpace travel spends fuel with displacement accounting; the map estimates destination fuel and depicts known influence. QuasiSpace changes fuel behavior and maps exits to different coordinates.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Surface nodes are generated from scan seeds and retrieval is tracked separately in masks; planet state is read/written and saved with the campaign. A regenerated layout need not mean restored stock.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Minerals exchange for resource units at the starbase, biological data and new special-world reports for Melnorme credits, then credits for fuel, technology and information. Different acquisitions feed distinct buyers and useful outputs.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Calendar events are ordered by authored dates and call C handlers. Portal recurrence, fleet changes and delayed local consequences happen through those handlers, not a universal autonomous NPC planner.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Starbase bulletins read actual flags, remember delivery and support repetition; some non-repeat bulletin branches also grant escorts, so repeating text must be kept separate from repeating a grant.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: The tagged binary save includes carrier, flags, queues, clock/events, planet and group state. The inspected writer opens the destination with wb and deletes it on detected I/O failure; load mutates global state before full completion. These functions do not demonstrate atomic safe restore.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: Species ship implementations specialize tactical behavior over shared controls. Arilou AI considers imminent threats and energy for teleport use; Spathi AI conditions a rear-directed special on relative facing and approach. This is bounded tactical AI, not evidence of social daily lives.

findings.label: SHOWN
findings.claim: The inspected default mineral path truncates accepted cargo to free hold space, then marks the node retrieved without retaining a remainder quantity. Depletion persistence alone does not prove conservation.

gaps: All reachable predicate combinations and all dialogue prose not semantically reviewed
Whole tactical AI and combat balance not audited
Installed Free Stars build not compared
No game launch, build or native persistence test
